These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 2 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.
- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money and round_money: Convert any monetary input with `to_money` from `ledgerly.money` and store it rounded with `round_money`; compare against `ZERO` rather than a literal Decimal.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 2 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid billing input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with codes like `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount`, matching the existing `issue_invoice` pattern.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 2 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0009] Refuse bool and float numeric inputs: Numeric helpers must reject bool and float arguments (raise BillingError) and parse via Decimal(str(value)), mirroring to_money in ledgerly/money.py.
  (learned from task S02 on ledgerly 2.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0006] Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: if `ledgerly.audit.events()` already has an entry with that key, return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
  WARNING: learned on version 1.0.0, this checkout is 2.0.0. Check CHANGELOG.md before relying on it.

candidate.title: Round money only via round_money
candidate.content: Never round monetary values with Python's built-in round(); use ledgerly.money.round_money, which implements finance policy FIN-2026-07 banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Convert raw prices with ledgerly.money.to_money before dividing.
candidate.evidence_quote:
finance policy FIN-2026-07 switches all monetary rounding to
  banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`)

item.title: Raise BillingError with machine-readable codes
item.content: For invalid billing inputs raise ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a short snake_case code (e.g. "invalid_period") and the offending value as the message, rather than ValueError or a bare message.
